rounds.text: Royale Manor Hotels & Industries Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.95x [E2] which sits well below the sector benchmark of 2.3x [E7]. This valuation gap suggests the market has failed to account for the company's recent operational momentum, where profit growth is now outpacing one-year price growth by 18% [E56]. The business is clearly in a transition phase, as demonstrated by a 60% increase in capital work in progress, signaling a strategic commitment to future growth [E40]. While long-term sales growth has been stagnant [E14], the company has demonstrated a strong ability to scale, achieving 24% compounded sales growth over the last five years [E15]. Conceded: [E4], [E5], [E14], [E16], [E17], [E69], [E70]. The recent uptick in quarter-over-quarter sales [E65] combined with an ROA of 3.2% that outperforms the sector benchmark of 2.12% [E8] highlights an underlying efficiency that the current market capitalization of ₹ 60.4 Cr does not fully reflect [E3].
